name: nnit-studio
description: NNIT Studio - global music production, mixing, mastering, AI and collaboration platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB,DESKTOP,MOBILE -c auto "npm run dev -w @nnit-studio/api" "npm run dev -w @nnit-studio/web" "npm run dev -w @nnit-studio/desktop" "npm run start -w @nnit-studio/mobile"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n API,WEB -c auto "npm run dev -w @nnit-studio/api" "npm run dev -w @nnit-studio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nnit-studio/shared && npm run build -w @nnit-studio/audio-engine && npm run build -w @nnit-studio/ai-core && npm run build -w @nnit-studio/sdk && npm run build -w @nnit-studio/api && npm run build -w @nnit-studio/web && npm run build -w @nnit-studio/desktop
scripts.dev:v2: concurrently -n API,WEB -c auto "npm run dev -w @nnit-studio/api" "npm run dev -w @nnit-studio/web"
